description.en: Fills the given array (up to 3 elements) with the position the player-controlled character had just before the current event/cutscene took control, letting a script restore or reference that position later.
Array that receives the [x, y, z] position; passed by reference and filled in place.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).
